sources.title: GitHub - MLBott/RealmGen-AI: Flask-based procedural world generation ...
sources.snippet: Flask-based procedural world generation system that combines noise-based terrain algorithms with multi-threaded LLM crawlers to automatically populate large-scale fantasy maps with contextually-aware location descriptions, featuring a web-based editor for interactive map manipulation and JSON-based data persistence for cross-project integration. - MLBott/RealmGen-AI
